items.title: The Self-Improving Supply Chain: What We’re Learning From Amazon Connect Decisions and AI Agents in Production
items.summary: Today, supply chain teams are challenged by how long it takes to resolve urgent issues, and disruptions are estimated to cost the industry billions in losses each year. The problem isn’t a lack of trying. Teams are buried in coordination rather than focused on decisions. Legacy tools and processes can’t keep pace with a network […]
